title: Training data attribution in diffusion models via mirrored unlearning and noise-consistent skew
abstract: arXiv:2605.17938v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training data attribution (TDA) should enable generative model interpretability and foster a variety of related downstream tasks. Nonetheless, current TDA approaches lack reliability and robustness, preventing their adoption in real-world setups. In this paper, we take a decisive step towards more reliable and robust TDA for diffusion models. We propose to perform TDA with mirrored unlearning and noise-consistent skew (MUCS). The idea is to fine-tune a second model with bounded mirrored gradient ascent, and to measure the normalized skew of this model with respect to the original one using consistent noise samples. We show that, while being conceptually simple and generic, MUCS systematically outperforms existing methods on three different datasets by a large margin. translated_title: 基于镜像遗忘与噪声一致偏度的扩散模型训练数据归因
translated_abstract: 训练数据归因（TDA）应当能够实现生成模型的可解释性，并促进多种相关的下游任务。然而，当前的TDA方法缺乏可靠性和鲁棒性，阻碍了其在现实场景中的应用。在本文中，我们朝着为扩散模型实现更可靠、更鲁棒的TDA迈出了决定性的一步。我们提出使用镜像遗忘与噪声一致偏度（MUCS）来执行TDA。其核心思想是通过有界镜像梯度上升微调第二个模型，并使用一致的噪声样本来测量该模型相对于原始模型的归一化偏度。我们证明，尽管在概念上简单且通用，MUCS在三个不同的数据集上系统性地大幅超越现有方法。此外，我们还研究了核心设计选择对最终性能的影响，并分析了有影响力实例之间重叠方面的新颖特性。
tldr: 本文提出MUCS方法，通过有界镜像梯度上升微调辅助模型并利用一致噪声样本测量归一化偏度，为扩散模型实现了更可靠、更鲁棒的训练数据归因，在三个数据集上大幅超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MUCS, which performs training data attribution in diffusion models by fine-tuning an auxiliary model with bounded mirrored gradient ascent and measuring normalized skew using consistent noise samples, systematically outperforming existing methods by a large margin across three datasets.
